title: in4 or fp4?
body:
I've installed sucessfully. As I'm using 5090, I only download the fp4 flux model ckpt.
Here is a simple testing:
flux fp8 + sageattention + teacache, uni_pc_bh2, 25 steps, 896x1024, 5.1±0.05s
flux svdq fp4 ckpt + nunchaku dit/clip node, bf16, same paras, 4.9±0.05s.

The overhead is not big but stable, for 5090 it's fair perhaps.
And the image quality doesn't show notable loss. That's great.

Should I further try in4 version to see even better performance? Which one is meant to be better between in4 and fp4 ?
author: sipie800

comments.body: 5090 does not support INT4 models. Please use FP4, which is also of better quality.

title: depth-anything-large-hf will not load if it is outside the ComfyUI directory
body: The node to load the depth estimation model ¨depth-anything-large-hf¨ loads it from the models/checkpoints directory inside ComfyUI, if you have the models in another directory it will not load it.
author: shadday007

comments.body: I guess this is ComfyUI's logic. You can link your model to models/checkpoints or use ComfyUI's remapping.
